facts.text: I am trying to get more serious about taking care of my health.
My parents are dealing with some age-related issues.
I am worried about my own potential health risks because my parents are 62 and dealing with age-related issues.
I am particularly concerned about osteoporosis.
I am concerned about my vitamin D levels.
I don't get much sunlight, especially during the winter months.
I am concerned about potential interactions between vitamin D supplements and my other medications.
I want information about interactions between vitamin D supplements and blood thinners like warfarin.
I want information about interactions between vitamin D supplements and other medications, such as antacids and calcium supplements.
